in_sanskrit.name: आरण्यक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who lives in the forest, a forest dweller, a sage living in the forest. Aranyakas are texts that discuss the rituals to be performed in the forest.

in_hindi.name: आरण्यक
in_hindi.long_meaning: वनमें रहनेवाला, वनवासी, वनमें रहनेवाला ऋषि

in_tamil.name: ஆரண்யக
in_tamil.long_meaning: காடுகளில் வாசிக்கும், வனவாஸி, காடுகளில் வாசிக்கும் அறிவன்

in_telugu.name: ఆరణ్యక
in_telugu.long_meaning: జగళ్లో రేపు చేయబడును మరియు జగళ్లో రేపు చేయబడును సంబంధిత సంస్కృతం

in_marathi.name: Aranyak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aranyak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aranyak refers to someone who resides in or is associated with a forest.

in_bengali.name: Aranyak
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Forest Dweller
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aranyak একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Aranyak refers to someone who resides in or is associated with a forest.
